source.label: Williams Zig Zag factory instruction cards

supportingSources.label: Williams Wing Ding factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Zig Zag and add-a-ball Wing Ding reward racking nine balls in the backbox. Shoot up either side rather than at the tighter center saucer, then nudge upper exits toward a lit rack-ball lane or hole. Completing A-B-C-D lights the inner bottom lanes on Zig Zag; on Wing Ding, A-B-C-D or a full nine-ball rack can add a ball.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Zig Zag or Wing Ding, shoot up the wider side paths and nudge toward any lit rack-ball lane or saucer. Rack all nine backbox balls. On Zig Zag, the full rack lights the center hole for Special; on Wing Ding, the full rack or completing A-B-C-D adds a ball when enabled.
strategy.summary: The wider outside routes are easier and avoid the center saucer's direct rubber rebounds. Build the backbox rack through lit lanes and holes, then use the variant's completed-rack award only when Special or Extra Ball is active.

quickInfo.name: Rack a ball
quickInfo.summary: Score a lit hole, the top-center lane, or a lit outside bottom lane to add a backbox ball.

quickInfo.name: Full rack
quickInfo.summary: Nine balls light the center hole on Zig Zag and add a ball on Wing Ding.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D on Zig Zag
quickInfo.summary: Completing the four rollover lanes lights the two inside bottom lanes for Special.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D on Wing Ding
quickInfo.summary: Completing the four rollover lanes adds a ball when that award is enabled.

steps.text: Plunge for the top-center rack-ball lane when it is lit.
From either flipper, shoot the ball up the matching side instead of forcing the narrow center saucer.
Nudge bumper and saucer exits toward a lit rack-ball hole or outside bottom lane.
Complete missing A-B-C-D rollovers when the resulting Special or Extra Ball is enabled.
After the ninth ball is racked, collect the Zig Zag center-hole award or continue the Wing Ding additional ball.
Use lit upper and outside lanes to rack balls.
Keep shooting the wider side routes while tracking the backbox display.

machineSetup: Identify Zig Zag versus add-a-ball Wing Ding and confirm whether A-B-C-D, nine racked balls, and lit lanes award Special, replay, Extra Ball, or points.
Test all rack-ball lamps and switches, three saucer kickouts, top-center lane, outside and inside bottom lanes, A-B-C-D rollovers, backbox rack unit, bumpers, and slingshots.
